chunk:
deviations:
  - "Field names use camelCase (not OAGIS PascalCase) — DataWeave convention"
  - "productId maps to OAGIS Item/ItemID/ID — simplified to flat string"
  - "status enum simplified (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/DISCONTINUED) — OAGIS uses Status/Code free text"
  - "inventory{} sub-object is a canonical addition — OAGIS Item does not standardize QOH fields"
  - "pricing{} flattens OAGIS Price/Amount/CurrencyID hierarchy"
  - "classification{} maps to OAGIS Item/Classification/Codes — renamed for clarity"

description: |
  Canonical product/item entity schema across all client integrations.
  Maps from: QuickBooks Item, Salesforce Product2, NetSuite Item, ERP SKU catalogs.
  Maps to: any target inventory, CRM, or commerce system.
  OAGIS alignment: ItemType — key fields productId→ItemID/ID,
  name→Description/ShortDescription, classification→Classification/Codes,
  inventory.quantityOnHand→Quantity/QuantityTypeCode=OnHand.

properties:
  productId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical product identifier (use source system's primary key; prefix with system for cross-system uniqueness e.g. "QB-1234")
    example: "QB-1234"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    description: Source system identifiers — enables lookup from any system
    properties:
      quickbooksItemId:    { type: string, example: "1234" }
      salesforceProduct2Id: { type: string, example: "01t0000001234" }
      netsuiteInternalId:  { type: string, example: "5678" }
      erpSkuId:            { type: string }
      isbn:                { type: string, description: "ISBN-13 for physical books/publications", example: "978-0-306-40615-7" }

  name:
    type: string
    description: Product display name / short description
    example: "Intensified Algebra Volume 1 Student Activity Book"

  description:
    type: string
    description: Full product description

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DISCONTINUED]

  type:
    type: string
    enum: [INVENTORY, NON_INVENTORY, SERVICE, BUNDLE, DIGITAL]
    description: Product type — determines whether QOH tracking applies (INVENTORY only)

  classification:
    type: object
    description: Categorisation and taxonomy
    properties:

      subcategory:   { type: string }
